metadata.title: AI@UNCW Project Dashboard
metadata.identity: The AI Hub Orchestrates and GAABS Supports AI Builders.
metadata.subidentity: GAABS is the advanced tool-building arm within The AI Hub.
metadata.publicNotice: This public dashboard contains approved summary information only. Project-file-only information is not live-verified.

executiveSummary: The AI Hub and GAABS have moved from initial authorization into foundation-building and governed execution. Current work strengthens governance, shared consultation infrastructure, staff and faculty capability, responsible guidance, team project monitoring, defensible evaluation boundaries, and cross-institution learning opportunities.
priorities: Finish and test the Summer AI Institute hands-on workshop
Advance the AI advisory-framework memo through the appropriate review path
Confirm the Digital Consultation Lab schedule and access workflow
Complete the AI@UNCW and ITS guidance feedback cycle
Define descriptive adoption monitoring and requirements for any future prospective study

accomplishments.title: Shared consultation model established
accomplishments.description: A Library-facilitated model was established for the Digital Consultation Lab.
accomplishments.value: Creates a shared, institutionally grounded path for campus AI consultation.

accomplishments.title: Governance path clarified
accomplishments.description: An appropriate senior-review path was established for the AI advisory framework.
accomplishments.value: Moves governance design forward while preserving existing authorities and approval boundaries.

accomplishments.title: Agent survey test completed
accomplishments.description: An inventory and test submission advanced the survey workstream.
accomplishments.value: Improves the evidence base for understanding local AI-building activity.

accomplishments.title: Summer AI Institute materials prepared
accomplishments.description: Two presentations and a hands-on workshop path were prepared; preparation is not recorded as delivery.
accomplishments.value: Creates reusable capacity-building materials while preserving the preparation-versus-delivery boundary.

accomplishments.title: University Advancement AI learning session delivered
accomplishments.description: Delivered a hands-on University Advancement AI learning session.
accomplishments.value: Built staff capability and reinforced a hands-on approach to AI learning.

accomplishments.title: Responsible-use and builder-showcase materials developed
accomplishments.description: Developed responsible-use guidance and builder-showcase materials with review controls.
accomplishments.value: Creates a review-ready foundation for responsible public engagement.

accomplishments.title: Team project-monitoring dashboard launched
accomplishments.description: A shared project-monitoring dashboard was launched for the team.
accomplishments.value: Provides a shared view of priorities, risks, decisions, and dependencies.

accomplishments.title: Cross-institution exchange opportunity opened
accomplishments.description: A discussion with an external university partner opened possibilities for talks, workshops, and related exchanges.
accomplishments.value: Creates a bounded path for cross-institution learning without implying a formal partnership or commitment.

risks.statement: Draft materials could be mistaken for approved policy or broad service availability.
risks.mitigation: Keep draft and review labels visible and publish only through an authorized route.

risks.statement: AI advisory work could be misunderstood as replacing established shared governance.
risks.mitigation: State advisory limits explicitly and recognize existing authorities.

risks.statement: Workshop access, network, pacing, or login issues could disrupt delivery.
risks.mitigation: Test the complete participant path and maintain a safe no-login fallback.

risks.statement: Late-July commitments could exceed available delivery capacity.
risks.mitigation: Protect Institute and Advancement delivery windows, sequence new work behind the Institute, and keep new commitments bounded.

risks.statement: The shared consultation model could be described inaccurately as GAABS-owned or GAABS-only.
risks.mitigation: Use shared-space language that recognizes Library facilitation and the broader consultation role.

risks.statement: The completed EDU-license rollout could be misrepresented as an effectiveness study even though it was not systematic or study-coordinated.
risks.mitigation: Describe available evidence only as descriptive adoption monitoring and require advance coordination before any future prospective evaluation.
